units.source_text: “歌谣嘛，是在练舞时听熟的，算是勉强凑合吧。

en.t: “As for songs, the ones I got used to hearing while practicing dance are just about manageable, I suppose.

units.source_text: 可是新歌大多是从广播里学来的，也不知行不行。

en.t: But most of the newer songs I learned from the radio, so I do not know whether they are any good.

units.source_text: 其中还掺进了自己的唱法，一定很可笑吧。

en.t: My own way of singing gets mixed in too, so I am sure it must sound ridiculous.

units.source_text: 而且在熟人面前唱不出口哩。

en.t: Besides, I cannot bring myself to sing in front of people I know.

units.source_text: 要不是熟人，还能放开嗓门唱唱。”

en.t: If they are strangers, I can still open up and sing loudly.”

units.source_text: 她说着有点羞羞答答，摆好架势，好像在说“来吧”就等着对方点歌，直勾勾地盯住岛村的脸。

en.t: As she said this, looking a little bashful, she took up her pose as if saying, “Go ahead,” waiting for him to request a song, and stared straight at Shimamura’s face.
